probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Overview Buy Hemingway Magazine Fashion Design Music Culture Travel Podcast Latest: Making records slowly About Authors Membership Contact Sign in The tailor who refuses to hurry Making records slowly Sofia Marchetti designs about six record sleeves a year. We talk about saying no, paper stock and why she still sketches every cover by hand. Sofia Marchetti, sleeve designer Episode 4 1 October 2026 , 42 min With Erik Lindqvist Design 0:00 of 42 min Back 15s Forward 15s Show notes Sofia Marchetti has designed sleeves for small labels in Milan and Berlin for fifteen years. She takes on about six records a year and turns down most of what she is offered. In this episode Why she listens to a record ten times before she draws anything Choosing paper that feels right in the hand The sleeve she would redesign if she could From the conversation Erik: Do you ever design before you hear the music? Sofia: Never. The sleeve is the first thing people hold, so it has to sound like the record before anyone presses play.
